m3_current_role.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.m3_current_role()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select role from public.profiles where id = auth.uid()
    and (role <> 'teacher' or teacher_status = 'approved');
$function$

m3_owns_material.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.m3_owns_material(target_material_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.uploaded_materials as material
    where material.id = target_material_id
      and material.uploaded_by = auth.uid()
  )
$function$

m3_material_is_unreferenced.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.m3_material_is_unreferenced(target_material_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    not exists (
      select 1
      from public.modules as module_row
      where module_row.source_material_id = target_material_id
    )
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.comprehension_questions as question
      where question.material_id = target_material_id
    )
$function$

m3_storage_object_is_deletable.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.m3_storage_object_is_deletable(target_storage_path text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    not exists (
      select 1
      from public.uploaded_materials as material
      where material.storage_path = target_storage_path
    )
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.uploaded_materials as material
      where material.storage_path = target_storage_path
        and public.m3_material_is_unreferenced(material.id)
    )
$function$

m3_can_manage_module.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.m3_can_manage_module(target_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case public.m3_current_role()
    when 'admin' then true
    when 'teacher' then exists (
      select 1 from public.modules as module_row
      where module_row.id = target_id and module_row.created_by = auth.uid()
    )
    else false
  end
$function$

m3_can_read_module.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.m3_can_read_module(target_module_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.modules as module_row
    where module_row.id = target_module_id
      and (
        public.m3_current_role() = 'admin'
        -- An approved Teacher reads every module they created, drafts included.
        or (public.m3_current_role() = 'teacher' and module_row.created_by = auth.uid())
        or (
          module_row.status = 'published'
          and public.m3_current_role() in ('teacher', 'student', 'general_user')
        )
      )
  )
$function$

m3_require_admin.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.m3_require_admin()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null or public.m3_current_role() is distinct from 'admin' then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'Admin access is required to manage reading modules';
  end if;
end $function$

m3_trashed_modules.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.m3_trashed_modules()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, title text, status_before text, trashed_at timestamp with time zone, trashed_by_name text, ever_published boolean, has_history boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  -- Approved Teachers see only the modules they created AND moved to the Trash; everyone else needs Admin.
  if public.m3_current_role() is distinct from 'teacher' then perform public.m3_require_admin(); end if;
  return query
    select m.id, m.title, coalesce(t.status_before, m.status), coalesce(t.trashed_at, m.deleted_at),
      coalesce(nullif(p.full_name, ''), nullif(p.nickname, ''), 'Admin'),
      m.published_at is not null, public.m3_deletion_has_history(m.id)
    from public.modules m
    left join public.m3_module_trash t on t.module_id = m.id
    left join public.profiles p on p.id = t.trashed_by
    where m.deleted_at is not null
      and (public.m3_current_role() = 'admin' or (t.trashed_by = auth.uid() and m.created_by = auth.uid()))
    order by coalesce(t.trashed_at, m.deleted_at) desc;
end $function$

m3_module_revisions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.m3_module_revisions(target_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, title text, status text, revision_number integer, revision_of uuid, published_at timestamp with time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone, in_trash boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare root uuid;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null or public.m3_current_role() is distinct from 'admin' then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'Admin access is required';
  end if;
  select coalesce(m.revision_root, m.id) into root from public.modules m where m.id = target_id;
  return query
    select m.id, m.title, m.status, coalesce(m.revision_number, 1), m.revision_of, m.published_at, m.created_at, m.deleted_at is not null
    from public.modules m where m.id = root or m.revision_root = root
    order by coalesce(m.revision_number, 1);
end $function$
